import struct
from unicorn import *
from unicorn.x86_const import *
d=open('/workspace/rap','rb').read()
BASE=0x400000
SZ=0x10000
mu=Uc(UC_ARCH_X86,UC_MODE_64)
mu.mem_map(BASE,SZ*4)
mu.mem_write(BASE,d[:SZ*4] if len(d)>=SZ*4 else d+b'\0'*(SZ*4-len(d)))
STACK=0x7000000; mu.mem_map(STACK,0x10000)
OBJ=0x8000000; mu.mem_map(OBJ,0x1000)   # fake string object
BUF=0x8001000; mu.mem_map(BUF,0x1000)  # string data
SENT=0x9000000; mu.mem_map(SENT,0x1000)
N=43
def run(s):
    mu.mem_write(BUF, s.ljust(0x100,b'\0'))
    mu.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RSP, STACK+0x8000)
    mu.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RBP, STACK+0x8000)
    mu.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RDI, OBJ)
    mu.mem_write(OBJ, struct.pack('<Q',BUF))
    # push sentinel return
    rsp=STACK+0x8000-8
    mu.mem_write(rsp, struct.pack('<Q',SENT))
    mu.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RSP, rsp)
    mu.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RBP, rsp)
    mu.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RDI, OBJ)
    def hook(uc, addr, size, ud):
        rip=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RIP)
        if addr==0x400b30:  # length
            uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RAX,N)
        elif addr==0x400af0:  # operator[]
            idx=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RSI)
            uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RAX,BUF+idx)
        elif addr==0x400ab0:  # memcpy: rdi dst rsi src rdx n
            dst=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RDI); src=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RSI); n=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RDX)
            uc.mem_write(dst, bytes(uc.mem_read(src,n)))
            uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RAX,dst)
        else:
            return
        # simulate ret
        sp=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RSP)
        ret=struct.unpack('<Q',bytes(uc.mem_read(sp,8)))[0]
        uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RSP,sp+8)
        uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RIP,ret)
    h=mu.hook_add(UC_HOOK_CODE,hook,begin=0x400ab0,end=0x400b40)
    mu.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RIP,0x400ce0)
    # stop at sentinel
    mu.mem_write(SENT,b'\xf4')
    try:
        mu.emu_start(0x400ce0,SENT,timeout=5000000,count=200000)
    except UcError as e:
        return ('err',str(e),mu.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RIP))
    r=mu.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RAX)&0xffffffff
    mu.hook_del(h)
    return r
